## Packages and data
```{r start}
rm(list=ls())

### Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(rje)
library(performance)
library(sjPlot)
library(corrplot)
library(parallel)
library(doParallel)
library(foreach)
library(data.table)

run.date <- Sys.Date()

### Read in and clean data
# Cover is summed species cover of vascular plants (can exceed 100% where plants overlap)
# Built by Scripts/1_DataPrep/VegetationData/surfaceCoverfromSpecCover_final.R -> Scripts/1_DataPrep/AnalysisData/PlantCover_AnalysisDataPrep.Rmd
dats.orig=read_csv('Data/AnalysisData/vascplantcover_final.csv') %>% 
  filter(!is.na(start.plantCover)) %>% 
  mutate(PSaspect=paste(park,summit,aspect,sep=".")) %>% 
  relocate(c(change.cover),.after = end.plantCover) %>% 
    arrange(-change.cover) %>% 
  mutate(park = factor(park,levels=rev(c("GNP","YNP","RMN","GSD","PEC"))),
         tr.num = str_sub(transition,4,4))

dats = dats.orig %>% 
  na.omit()

### Create another dataframe where numeric predictor variables are scaled ###
dats.scaled = dats # Get names columns to standardize
scale_cols = dats %>% select(start.plantCover,climPC1,climPC2,sitelat,contains(c(".tmean",".aet",".pet",".ppt",".snowdays",".gdd"))) %>% names()
dats.scaled[scale_cols]=lapply(dats.scaled[scale_cols], function(x) scale(x))

rm(scale_cols)
```

## Did total vascular plant cover change overall and by park?
```{r direction_test_totalcover}
# Reviewer 2 (general comment: overall community dynamics to set the scene for abundance changes)
# Intercept = mean change in % cover per summit-aspect; CI excluding 0 = systematic change
cover.mod = lmer(change.cover ~ 1 + (1|transition), data = dats, REML = TRUE)
# confint(cover.mod, parm = "beta_", method = "Wald")
summary(cover.mod)

# By park
cover.park.mod = lmer(change.cover ~ 0 + park + (1|transition), data = dats, REML = TRUE)
confint(cover.park.mod, parm = "beta_", method = "Wald")
summary(cover.park.mod)
```

## Are forb and graminoid cover increasing or decreasing?
```{r direction_test}
# Editor & Reviewer 1 (line 27): community-level check on species-level result that graminoids increased in cover more than forbs
# Intercept = mean change in % cover per summit-aspect; CI excluding 0 = systematic change
forb.mod = lmer(change.forbCover ~ 1 + (1|transition), data = dats, REML = TRUE)
gram.mod = lmer(change.gramCover ~ 1 + (1|transition), data = dats, REML = TRUE)
confint(forb.mod, parm = "beta_", method = "Wald")
confint(gram.mod, parm = "beta_", method = "Wald")

# By park
forb.park.mod = lmer(change.forbCover ~ 0 + park + (1|transition), data = dats, REML = TRUE)
gram.park.mod = lmer(change.gramCover ~ 0 + park + (1|transition), data = dats, REML = TRUE)

summary(forb.park.mod)

confint(forb.park.mod, parm = "beta_", method = "Wald")
confint(gram.park.mod, parm = "beta_", method = "Wald")
```

## Model selection for change in total vascular plant cover (steps 1-4)
Reviewer 2 (general comment): the "simple models" of change in total vascular plant cover, built with the same model selection procedure as the species-level models

1. Find random effect structure
```{r REstructure}

###### Full fixed effects model before any winnowing of FE variables #######

mod1 <- lmer(end.plantCover ~ start.plantCover*(climPC1+climPC2+sitelat) + (1|PSaspect),
             na.action = "na.fail",data = dats.scaled,REML = TRUE)

mod2 <- lmer(end.plantCover ~ start.plantCover*(climPC1+climPC2+sitelat) + (1|transition),
             na.action = "na.fail",data = dats.scaled,REML = TRUE)

mod3 <- lmer(end.plantCover ~ start.plantCover*(climPC1+climPC2+sitelat) + (1|PSaspect) + (1|transition),
             na.action = "na.fail",data = dats.scaled,REML = TRUE)

AICc(mod1)
AICc(mod2)
AICc(mod3)
```


2. Find fixed structure with climate PCs 1 & 2 #####
Refit best RE model using ML + dredge to find the most important fixed effects
```{r FEstructure_refitwithML_thenDredge}

# Refit using ML rather than REML
climPC.RE.mod.MLfit = lmer(end.plantCover ~ start.plantCover*(climPC1+climPC2+sitelat) + (1|transition),
             na.action = "na.fail",data = dats.scaled,REML = FALSE)
climPC.RE.mod.MLfit %>% summary()

climPC.RE.mod.dredge = dredge(climPC.RE.mod.MLfit, beta = c("none"), fixed = c('start.plantCover'),trace=2)

best.climPC.fe.mod = get.models(climPC.RE.mod.dredge,subset = 1)[[1]]
top10.climPC.fe.mods = get.models(climPC.RE.mod.dredge,subset = 1:10)

saveRDS(object = list(bestMod = best.climPC.fe.mod,top10.climPC.fe.mods = top10.climPC.fe.mods),
        file = paste0("Results/climPC_models_plantCover_",run.date,".rds"))

climPC.RE.mod.dredge.fltr = as.data.frame(climPC.RE.mod.dredge) %>% slice_head(n = 10)
write_csv(climPC.RE.mod.dredge.fltr,paste0("Results/climPC_plantCover_dredge_results_",run.date,".csv"))
```

3. Take that model with the optimal FE and RE structure find best explicit climate variables in nested loops
```{r best.clim.vars}

best.climPC.mods <- readRDS(paste0("Results/climPC_models_plantCover_",run.date,".rds"))
best.climPC.mod = best.climPC.mods$bestMod
summary(best.climPC.mod)

# Replace climPC1/2 with generic clim var names
climVar.generic.mod = c("end.plantCover ~ start.plantCover*(sitelat + tmean.var + cwd.var + ppt.var + snow.gdd.var) + (1 | transition)")

# Create climate variable variable groups
val = c("min","max","mean")
tmean.grp = append(paste0(val,".tmean"),NA)
snow.gdd.grp = append(c(paste0(val,".gdd"),paste0(val,".snowdays")),NA)
ppt.grp = append(paste0(val,".gs.ppt"),NA)
cwd.grp =  append(c(paste0(val,".aet"),paste0(val,".pet"),paste0(val,".wy.ppt")),NA)
rm(val)

climVar_param_grid <- expand_grid(tmean.grp,snow.gdd.grp,ppt.grp,cwd.grp) %>%
  filter(!if_all(everything(), is.na))

# In each iteration, a single climate variable from each group is subbed in for the generic climate variables above (i.e., tmean.var is swapped out for mean.tmean). That model is then fit with ML (not REML) and the AIC value is stored in the output table for comparison once the loops are finished running

#### Initiate cluster #####
clust = makeCluster(spec = 2)
registerDoParallel(cl = clust)

results_list <- foreach::foreach(i = 1:nrow(climVar_param_grid), .packages = c("tidyverse","data.table","lme4","performance","MuMIn") )%dopar%{
  
  row.i <- climVar_param_grid[i,]
  
  tmean.i <- row.i$tmean.grp
  cwd.i <- row.i$cwd.grp
  ppt.i <- row.i$ppt.grp
  snow.gdd.i <- row.i$snow.gdd.grp
  
  clim.mod.i = climVar.generic.mod 
  
  # If all clim vals are NA skip to next loop
  # if(is.na(tmean.i)&is.na(cwd.i)&is.na(ppt.i)&is.na(snow.gdd.i)) next
  
  # either remove tmean.var or replace with specific tmean variable name. Repeat the same process for all other clim variable groups
  if(is.na(tmean.i)) {clim.mod.i = gsub(pattern = "tmean.var + ",replacement = "", x = clim.mod.i, fixed = T)
  }else{clim.mod.i = gsub(pattern = "tmean.var",replacement = tmean.i,x = clim.mod.i)}
  
  if(is.na(cwd.i)) {clim.mod.i = gsub(pattern = "cwd.var + ",replacement = "", x = clim.mod.i, fixed = T)
  }else{clim.mod.i = gsub(pattern = "cwd.var",replacement = cwd.i,x = clim.mod.i)}
          
  if(is.na(ppt.i)) {clim.mod.i = gsub(pattern = "ppt.var + ",replacement = "", x = clim.mod.i, fixed = T)
  }else{clim.mod.i = gsub(pattern = "ppt.var",replacement = ppt.i,x = clim.mod.i)}
  
  if(is.na(snow.gdd.i)) {clim.mod.i = gsub(pattern = " + snow.gdd.var",replacement = "", x = clim.mod.i, fixed = T)
  }else{clim.mod.i = gsub(pattern = "snow.gdd.var",replacement = snow.gdd.i,x = clim.mod.i)}
  
  out_df = data.table(tmean.var = tmean.i,
            snow.gdd.var = snow.gdd.i,
            ppt.var = ppt.i,
            cwd.var = cwd.i,
            mod.str = clim.mod.i)
  
   # Fit in LMER
    mod.fit.i = lmer(formula = clim.mod.i, data = dats.scaled, REML = FALSE, na.action = "na.fail")

    out_df$AICc=AICc(mod.fit.i)
    out_df$condR2 = r2(mod.fit.i)[[1]]
    out_df$margR2 = r.squaredGLMM(mod.fit.i)[[1]]
    return(out_df)

}
stopCluster(clust)
clim.mod.AICs <- rbindlist(results_list)

clim.mod.AICs$delta = clim.mod.AICs$AICc - min(clim.mod.AICs$AICc)
clim.mod.AICs <- clim.mod.AICs %>% arrange(delta)

best.ExplClimVar.mod.str <- clim.mod.AICs$mod.str[clim.mod.AICs$delta==0]
best.ExplClimVar.mod.str
```


4. With the best climate variables, revisit random slopes letting all combos of best clim variables be random slopes
```{r explClimVars.REs}

###### Full fixed effects model before any winnowing of FE variables #######
mod1 <- lmer(end.plantCover ~ start.plantCover*(sitelat + mean.wy.ppt + mean.gs.ppt + max.snowdays) + sitelat*aspect + (1|PSaspect),
             na.action = "na.fail",data = dats.scaled,REML = TRUE)

mod2 <- lmer(end.plantCover ~ start.plantCover*(sitelat + mean.wy.ppt + mean.gs.ppt + max.snowdays) + (1|transition),
             na.action = "na.fail",data = dats.scaled,REML = TRUE)

mod3 <- lmer(end.plantCover ~ start.plantCover*(sitelat + mean.wy.ppt + mean.gs.ppt + max.snowdays) + (1|PSaspect) + (1|transition),
             na.action = "na.fail",data = dats.scaled,REML = TRUE)

AICc(mod1)
AICc(mod2)
AICc(mod3)

## Mod 2 is the best model here
# > AICc(mod1)
# [1] 923.4103
# > AICc(mod2)
# [1] 916.8994
# > AICc(mod3)
# [1] 919.3503

# Save best explicit-climate model (mod2, REML fit) and the full climate-variable AICc table
saveRDS(object = list(bestMod = mod2, clim.mod.AICs = clim.mod.AICs),
        file = paste0("Results/climVar_models_plantCover_",run.date,".rds"))
write_csv(clim.mod.AICs,paste0("Results/climVar_plantCover_AICc_results_",run.date,".csv"))
```

```{r}
coverMod <- readRDS("Results/climVar_models_plantCover_2026-10-20.rds")[[1]]
summary(coverMod)
sjPlot::plot_model(coverMod)

sjPlot::plot_model(coverMod,type="pred")
sjPlot::plot_model(coverMod,type="int")

# Predicted change (predicted end - start) at the actual data points, each with its own climate and start cover
coverMod.us = lmer(formula(coverMod), data = dats, REML = TRUE)   # refit on unscaled data

cover_pred_df = dats %>%
  mutate(pred.endcover = predict(coverMod.us, newdata = ., re.form = NA),
         pred.changecover = pred.endcover - start.plantCover,
         park2 = case_when(park=="GNP"~"GLAC",
                           park=="YNP"~"YELL",
                           park=="RMN"~"ROMO",
                           park=="GSD"~"GRSD",
                           park=="PEC"~"PECO"),
         park2 = factor(park2,levels=rev(c("GLAC","YELL","ROMO","GRSD","PECO"))))

park.pal = c(GLAC='#B07AA1',YELL='#1170AA',ROMO='#59A14F',GRSD='#E6AB02',PECO='#C85200')

ggplot(cover_pred_df, aes(x = start.plantCover, y = pred.changecover, color = park2)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method="lm",se=F)+
  scale_color_manual(values = park.pal) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  labs(x = "Start cover", y = "Predicted change in cover", color = "Park")

# Forest plot of fixed effects (as in Manu figures Figs 18-19), from the scaled model so effects are comparable
coverMod.coefs = broom.mixed::tidy(coverMod, effects = "fixed") %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = rev(term)))

ggplot(coverMod.coefs, aes(x = estimate, y = term, color = estimate > 0)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = estimate - std.error*1.96, xmax = estimate + std.error*1.96), width = 0.25) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(estimate, 2)), vjust = -1, fontface = "bold") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "Estimate (per 1 SD)", y = "") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red3", "dodgerblue3"))
```
